functions.name: get_article_view_counts
functions.title: Get article view counts
functions.description: Returns a map of article IDs to total view counts across all articles. Admin access only. Call when you need analytics on how many times articles have been read.

functions.name: list_article_comments
functions.title: List approved comments for an article
functions.description: Returns all approved (publicly visible) comments for a given article, excluding commenter email addresses. Call when you need to see reader discussion on a specific article.

articleId.description: The ID of the article whose comments to retrieve.

functions.name: post_article_comment
functions.title: Post a comment on an article
functions.description: Posts a new comment on an article. Signed-in users' comments are auto-approved; guest comments require a name and email and go to moderation. Rate-limited to 3 comments per email every 5 minutes. Call when a user wants to leave a comment on an article.

articleId.description: The ID of the article to comment on.

content.description: The comment text. Must be at least 3 characters and at most 2000.

authorName.description: Display name for the commenter. Required for guest comments; optional for signed-in users (uses their account name).

authorEmail.description: Email address for the commenter. Required for guest comments; optional for signed-in users (uses their account email).

functions.name: subscribe_to_newsletter
functions.title: Subscribe to the newsletter
functions.description: Subscribes an email address to the RaisingIndia newsletter. If the email is already subscribed, it reactivates the subscription. Call when a user wants to join the mailing list.

email.description: The email address to subscribe. Must be a valid email.
